Play first. English rides along.先玩，英文順便上車。

Game types01 / 10

Ten games a browser can run.瀏覽器跑得動的十種遊戲

Pick the game first, the way a player would. Then ask what it secretly teaches.先像玩家一樣挑遊戲，再問它偷偷教了什麼。

Every teacher has seen a "language game" die in the first minute. It looks like a game, but under the confetti it's a worksheet, and students smell it. Game designers have a name for this: chocolate-covered broccoli.每個老師都看過「語言遊戲」在第一分鐘就陣亡。看起來像遊戲，彩帶底下其實是學習單，學生一聞就知道。遊戲設計師管這叫「巧克力包花椰菜」。

This issue goes the other way. Each game here is a real genre, the kind people play for fun, built as one HTML file that runs in a phone browser. English sits inside the things the game already needs: names, menus, logs, choices, reactions. Nobody is quizzed. The game just can't be played without reading a little.這期反過來做。這裡的每一款都是真正的遊戲類型，是人們本來就會為了好玩而玩的那種，做成一個能在手機瀏覽器跑的 HTML 檔。英文藏在遊戲本來就需要的地方：名字、選單、紀錄、選項、反應。沒有人被考試，只是不讀一點就玩不下去。

How to read the cards怎麼看這些卡

Loop: what the player does again and again.循環：玩家一再重複做的事。

Build: plain page elements (DOM) or a drawn canvas; turn-based or real-time.做法：一般網頁元素（DOM）或畫布（canvas）；回合制或即時。

Secret: the English the player picks up without being asked.祕密：玩家沒被要求、卻自然學到的英文。

Life sim生活模擬

Loop Fill a calendar, watch the days play out, read the results.排行程、看日子過去、讀結果。

Build DOM, turn-based. The easiest kind to build well.DOM、回合制。最容易做好的一種。

Secret Daily-life English in short first-person lines, read at your own pace.生活英文，第一人稱短句，按自己的速度讀。

Window Seat → p. 3

Side-scroller橫向捲軸

Loop Run, jump, grab, dodge.跑、跳、撿、閃。

Build Canvas, real-time, a game loop at 60 frames a second.canvas、即時、每秒 60 格的遊戲迴圈。

Secret Very little while running, and that's the point. Words come as short reactions and in the calm scene after.跑的時候學得很少，這正是重點。字只以短短的反應出現，之後的平靜場景才是讀的時候。

The camping hike → p. 4

Visual novel視覺小說

Loop Read, choose, live with it.讀、選、承擔後果。

Build DOM over a picture, turn-based, driven by a script file.圖片上疊 DOM、回合制、由劇本檔驅動。

Secret Register and tone: how you say it changes what happens.語域和語氣：怎麼說，決定接下來發生什麼。

Loop Collect cards, set a team, watch it fight, climb a floor.抽卡、排隊伍、看它打、爬一層樓。

Build DOM, the fight resolves by itself; numbers matter more than reflexes.DOM，戰鬥自動結算；數值比反應重要。

Secret Names, skills and a battle log, read again and again.卡名、技能、戰鬥紀錄，一讀再讀。

Clock Out → p. 6

Tabletop RPG companion桌遊 RPG 輔助程式

Loop Make a hero, play a session with friends and a teacher.做角色，和朋友、老師一起玩一場。

Build DOM apps that sit beside a real table: builder, guide, player's book.放在真實桌邊的 DOM 程式：角色建立器、主持人指南、玩家手冊。

Secret Speaking, but at the table, with people. The apps carry the reading.開口說，但在桌邊、和真人。程式負責閱讀的部分。

Kettlebrook → p. 7

Branching gamebook分支遊戲書

Loop Read a scene, pick a path.讀一段，選一條路。

Build DOM, turn-based, plain text plus a little state.DOM、回合制，純文字加一點狀態。

Secret Long reading with a reason to keep going.長篇閱讀，而且有讀下去的理由。

Keep Out, Achievement Unlocked → p. 8
Fun first, not built yet好玩優先，還沒做的四種

Point-and-click adventure點擊冒險

Loop Look at everything, pick things up, combine them, talk your way past people.到處看、撿東西、組合物品、靠嘴巴過關。

Build DOM or canvas hotspots over a painted room; turn-based.在畫好的房間上放可點區域，DOM 或 canvas；回合制。

Secret Object words and descriptions you need to solve the puzzle.物品名稱和描述，解謎時非讀不可。

Roguelite deck-builderRoguelite 牌組構築

Loop Short runs; add a card after each fight; lose, start again a little stronger.一局很短；每場戰鬥後加一張卡；輸了就重來，但更強一點。

Build DOM, turn-based, seeded random runs (the Clock Out engine already has most of it).DOM、回合制、可重現的隨機（Clock Out 的引擎已經有大半）。

Secret Card text read closely, because one word changes the plan.卡片文字要細讀，因為一個字就能改變策略。

Cozy crafting or farming療癒系製作／種田

Loop Plant, wait, harvest, make, sell, decorate.種、等、收、做、賣、佈置。

Build DOM or canvas; real time that pauses when you leave.DOM 或 canvas；離開就暫停的即時。

Secret Recipes and requests: follow steps, read what a neighbor wants.食譜和委託：照步驟做、讀懂鄰居要什麼。

Escape room密室逃脫

Loop One locked room, clues everywhere, a code to crack.一個上鎖的房間，到處是線索，破解一組密碼。

Build DOM, turn-based, a timer you can switch off.DOM、回合制，計時器可以關掉。

Secret Reading for detail: dates, numbers, who said what.抓細節的閱讀：日期、數字、誰說了什麼。

Speed against text速度與文字量

The more a game asks of your hands and eyes, the less English it can carry at the same moment. So the wordy games here are all turn-based, and the one fast game keeps its words tiny and saves the reading for the calm part after.遊戲越需要手和眼睛，同一時間能承載的英文就越少。所以這期文字多的遊戲全是回合制；唯一快節奏的那款，字很少，閱讀留到後面平靜的段落。

Nothing here sits in the red corner. That's on purpose.沒有一款落在紅色角落，是刻意的。

What the research says研究怎麼說
7×

Children played a math game Zombie Division about seven times longer when the math was the fighting itself, not a quiz between fights, and they learned more from it.當數學本身就是戰鬥方式，而不是戰鬥之間的小考時，孩子玩《Zombie Division》的時間大約是七倍，學到的也更多。

Habgood & Ainsworth, 2011
Gamers

Among 86 Swedish 11–12-year-olds, those who played English-language games five hours a week or more scored highest on vocabulary, ahead of moderate players and non-gamers.在 86 位 11 到 12 歲的瑞典孩子中，每週玩英文遊戲五小時以上的，詞彙分數最高，勝過偶爾玩和不玩的。

Sylvén & Sundqvist, 2012
+40%

Intermediate and advanced ESL students playing EverQuest II grew their vocabulary by about 40%, mostly through talking with the game's characters.中高級 ESL 學生玩《EverQuest II》詞彙量增加約四成，主要來自和遊戲角色的對話。

Rankin, Gold & Gooch, 2006
But…

Students who played a fast music game remembered less of its vocabulary than classmates who only watched. Playing took up the attention the words needed.親自玩快節奏音樂遊戲的學生，記得的詞彙反而比只在旁邊看的同學少。玩遊戲佔去了學字需要的注意力。

deHaan, Reed & Kuwada, 2010

Reviews of adventure and role-playing games find the same mix: a handful of studies suggest real benefit, with the gains depending on how the words are placed. Placement is the craft, and it's what the rest of this issue is about.冒險和角色扮演遊戲的文獻回顧也是同樣的結論：少數研究顯示確實有幫助，效果取決於字放在哪裡。擺放就是手藝，也是這期接下來要談的。

From the archive · Taiwan, 1993檔案室・1993 年的台灣

Role-playing games in the EFL classroomEFL 課堂裡的角色扮演遊戲

Thirty-three years ago, at a national English teaching conference in Taipei, B. D. Phillips described running tabletop role-playing games with Taiwanese students. Much of it still holds: keep the rules simple, give beginners prompts to describe what they do, turn the language itself into the puzzle, and ask players for comments after the game. His caution belongs beside every research box, this one included:三十三年前，在台北的全國英語文教學研討會上，B. D. Phillips 談到和台灣學生玩桌上角色扮演遊戲的經驗。很多觀點至今仍成立：規則要簡單、給初學者描述行動的提示、把語言本身變成謎題、遊戲結束後請玩家給意見。他的提醒適合放在每一則研究旁邊，包括這一則：

"We need to be wary of claiming the game can do more than it can."「我們必須小心，別宣稱遊戲能做到它做不到的事。」
Phillips, 1993, Proceedings of the Tenth National Conference on English Teaching and Learning in the ROC
Watch: the six games in this issue影片：本期的六款遊戲

One minute, no voice-over, works muted.一分鐘，沒有旁白，靜音也看得懂。

Under the hood02 / 10

One file, many games.一個檔案，很多遊戲

Six different games, one way of building them. Learn the parts once and every new game starts half done.六款不同的遊戲，同一套做法。零件學一次，每款新遊戲一開始就完成一半。

1

Content is data, not code內容是資料，不是程式

Story, cards and words live in plain files a writer can edit: a script for the visual novel, a table for the cards, a word list for the glossary. The engine reads them. Fixing a typo never means touching the rules.故事、卡片和單字都放在寫作者能直接改的檔案：視覺小說的劇本、卡片的表格、詞彙表。引擎讀取它們。修錯字永遠不必碰到規則。

2

Tap a word, any word任何字都能點

Mark a word in the text and the engine makes it tappable: pronunciation, a Chinese gloss, an example, and a speaker button. Tapped words collect in a notebook.在文字裡標記一個字，引擎就讓它可以點：音標、中文解釋、例句和發音按鈕。點過的字收進筆記本。

3

Read-aloud that says it right念得對的朗讀

The browser's own voices read every line for free. A small table of respellings fixes the words they get wrong, and foreign words switch to a native voice mid-sentence.瀏覽器內建的語音免費朗讀每一行。一張小小的拼讀修正表處理念錯的字，外語單字會在句子中途換成母語語音。

4

Music without music files沒有音樂檔的音樂

An FM synthesizer of about a hundred lines plays every song from notes written as text, so a whole soundtrack weighs less than one photo.大約一百行的 FM 合成器，用文字寫成的音符演奏每一首歌，整張原聲帶比一張照片還輕。

5

Bots play first機器人先玩

Before a person plays, a script walks every route of a story and simulates thousands of runs of a sim. It finds the dead end, the impossible ending, the job that pays too much.在真人玩之前，程式先走過故事的每條路線，並模擬上千局。它會找出死路、達不到的結局、太好賺的工作。

6

Art that fits the file放得進檔案的美術

Two pipelines: pixel art drawn by code, and AI paintings converted to a small pixel palette. Small pictures, packed inside the page.兩種流程：用程式畫的像素圖，以及把 AI 圖轉成少色像素。小小的圖，包在頁面裡。

Shared assets pay twice共用素材，加倍回本

The music player and the read-aloud voice weren't written for these games. They came from InkQuest's graded readers, Lamplight Readers, and their radio companion, Lamplight Radio. Each new game borrows them, and each fix flows back to the books.音樂播放器和朗讀語音不是為這些遊戲寫的，而是來自 InkQuest 的分級讀本 Lamplight Readers 和它的廣播節目 Lamplight Radio。每款新遊戲都借用它們，每次修正也會回到書裡。

The same goes for the look of a series: when a game shares its books' characters and art, a student meets familiar faces in both.系列的視覺也一樣：遊戲和書共用角色與美術，學生在兩邊都會遇到熟悉的面孔。

Designer note: four ways to offer Chinese設計筆記：提供中文的四種方式

Every game here lets the player reach for Chinese. The craft is in how far away it sits. Too close and nobody reads the English; too far and beginners quit.這裡每款遊戲都讓玩家能找到中文。手藝在於中文放多遠：太近，沒人讀英文；太遠，初學者就放棄。

Every game in this issue was played by real players first, and their comments changed it.本期每一款遊戲都先經過真實玩家試玩，他們的意見改變了遊戲。

Two examples you'll meet later: Window Seat's whole visual remake, and the 100-floor goal in Clock Out.後面會看到兩個例子：Window Seat 整個重做的畫面，以及 Clock Out 的一百層目標。

Life sim03 / 10

Plan two weeks. Live with them.排好兩週，然後承擔它

Window Seat: My Working Holiday is a Princess Maker-style life sim. Mia spends a year working and studying in Taipei, two weeks at a time.《Window Seat：我的打工度假》是《美少女夢工場》式的生活模擬。Mia 在台北工作、上課一年，每次兩週。

The trade-off is the game取捨就是遊戲本身

English class raises English and costs money. A café shift earns money and raises stress. A night market with a friend lowers stress and fills a heart. There's never time for all of it, so every plan is a small decision about what Mia wants this month.英文課提升英文但要花錢；咖啡店打工賺錢但壓力上升；和朋友逛夜市降低壓力、增加好感。永遠排不完，所以每次排程都是一個小決定：Mia 這個月想要什麼。

Build note: all DOM, turn-based, one save object. The simplest genre to build well, and the most forgiving to read in.製作筆記：全 DOM、回合制、一個存檔物件。最容易做好的類型，讀起來也最從容。

The language layer語言層

The text level follows the textbooks the game belongs to: A1 in the first stage, up to B2 in the last. Mia speaks in the first person and the present tense ("I forget my homework. I feel silly."), so every line is short, useful, and about something the player just chose.文字程度跟著遊戲所屬的課本走：第一階段 A1，最後階段到 B2。Mia 用第一人稱、現在式說話（「I forget my homework. I feel silly.」），所以每一句都短、實用，而且跟玩家剛做的選擇有關。

Menus are Chinese first, because nobody learns English from a Settings screen, and a lost player stops playing. The story is English, with a 中 button under each line and hand-marked tooltips on the hard words. Tapped words land in a notebook. English never blocks a choice; it opens extra ones.選單預設中文，因為沒有人是從設定畫面學英文的，迷路的玩家就不玩了。故事是英文，每行下面有中按鈕，難字有手工標記的提示。點過的字收進筆記本。英文從不擋住選項，只會打開更多選項。

Tools behind it幕後工具

build.py joins engine, content and 134 pictures into one page.把引擎、內容和 134 張圖組成一頁。

validate.js checks every gloss, sprite, story page and UI string.檢查每個詞彙、圖片、故事頁和介面文字。

balance.js plays the year in different styles to check money and stats.用不同玩法跑完一年，檢查金錢和能力值。

Art: AI paintings converted to a small pixel palette; music from the Lamplight FM player.美術：AI 圖轉成少色像素；音樂來自 Lamplight 的 FM 播放器。

Player-tested

Comments from the first players led to a complete visual remake: a cozy notebook with Mia's room as a taped photo, stat cards with icons and rank pills, a ruled planner, messages as a phone thread.第一批玩家的意見，促成了整個畫面的重做：溫暖的筆記本風格、Mia 的房間像貼上的照片、有圖示和等級標籤的能力卡、橫線排程表、手機對話式的訊息。

What's next下一步
A train day trip A small mini-game on a train ride out of the city, with the timetable and announcements as the reading.火車一日遊：出城的小遊戲，時刻表和廣播就是閱讀材料。
More mini-games One per season, each a different genre, each with its calm scene after.更多小遊戲：每季一個、每個不同類型，後面都有平靜的段落。
New Game+ Replay the year knowing more, with harder English and the Chinese help turned down.二周目：帶著經驗重玩一年，英文更難、中文輔助減少。
A teacher printout One page per block: the words met, the diary, three questions to talk about in class.教師列印頁：每個區塊一頁，遇到的單字、日記，以及三個課堂討論問題。
Side-scroller04 / 10

Berries first. Words second.先摘莓果，再看字

Inside Window Seat hides a 65-second side-scroller: a weekend hike to a campsite. Its English is almost all in the reactions.Window Seat 裡藏著一段 65 秒的橫向捲軸：週末健行到營地。它的英文幾乎都藏在反應裡。

Live demo · tap, click or press Space to jump現場示範・點一下或按空白鍵跳
🍓 0

Built for this page from the game's own sprites, a smaller cousin of the real hike.用遊戲本身的像素圖為這頁做的小版本，是正式健行的小表親。

The player's job is simple: jump to catch berries hanging over the path, and jump over stumps and rocks. Mushrooms and firewood lie along the trail too. Nothing on screen asks you to read while you run.玩家的任務很簡單：跳起來摘路上方的莓果，跳過樹樁和石頭。路邊也有香菇和柴火。跑的時候，畫面上沒有任何東西要你閱讀。

Words only appear as a reaction to what just happened. Bump a stump: Ouch! Lose a berry: A berry rolls away… Run out of hearts and Mia sits down: I need a rest…, then OK, let's go! Each one is two to five words, and each one names a feeling the player just had.字只在事情發生後以反應出現。撞到樹樁：「Ouch!」掉了一顆莓果：「A berry rolls away…」愛心用完，Mia 坐下來：「I need a rest…」然後「OK, let's go!」每句二到五個字，每句都說出玩家剛剛的感受。

There's no game over. A tired hiker rests and walks on. A player who has already done the hike once can skip it and take an average result.沒有遊戲結束。累了就休息再走。已經玩過一次的玩家可以跳過，拿平均成績。

The speed lesson速度的教訓

Remember the research on page 1: players of a fast game remembered fewer words than people who watched. Fast hands and new words compete for the same attention.記得第 1 頁的研究嗎？玩快節奏遊戲的人記得的字，比旁觀的人少。快速的手和新的字在搶同一份注意力。

So the hike splits the work. While running: a few words you can feel. After: the camp, where nothing moves until you tap.所以健行把工作拆開。跑的時候：幾個感受得到的字。之後：營地，不點就不會動。

Then the calm part: camp接著是平靜的段落：營地

At camp the game slows right down and asks for real reading. Pitch the tent: four picture cards, tap the steps in order. Build the fire: how much firewood you carried decides how big it gets. Dinner: what you picked on the trail ends up in the pot. Then a starry night, an owl, and a score card.到了營地，遊戲慢下來，開始需要真正的閱讀。搭帳篷：四張圖卡，依順序點步驟。生火：帶了多少柴火決定火有多大。晚餐：路上撿的東西都進了鍋裡。接著是滿天星斗、一隻貓頭鷹，和一張成績卡。

The fast part makes the slow part matter: the berries you jumped for are the dessert you read about.快的段落讓慢的段落有意義：你跳起來摘的莓果，就是你讀到的那道甜點。

Also in Window SeatWindow Seat 裡還有

The Mid-Autumn stall. Three nights at a night-market stall, each night a choice about how to sell, ending on the festival itself.中秋夜市攤位：在夜市擺攤三晚，每晚選擇怎麼賣，最後一晚就是中秋節。

 

Christmasland. The stage finale: New Taipei's winter lights, then the countdown to the new year at Taipei 101.耶誕城：階段的結尾，新北的冬季燈海，接著是台北 101 的跨年倒數。

What's next下一步
One hike per season The same engine, new trails and new reactions: a beach in summer, a rainy mountain path in spring.每季一條步道：同一個引擎，新路線、新反應，夏天海邊、春天下雨的山路。
Words you can collect A reaction you've seen once becomes tappable in the camp scene, so the feeling and the word meet twice.可收集的字：看過一次的反應，在營地場景裡可以點，感受和字見第二次面。
Visual novel05 / 10

Sweet, bold or sly?甜、直，還是狡猾？

The Villainess Has Read the Book: Eve wakes up as the villain of a romance novel she knows by heart, and has one season to dodge the ending.《反派千金讀過原著》：Eve 醒來變成一本她倒背如流的愛情小說裡的反派，只有一季時間躲開結局。

A visual novel is the most reading-friendly game there is: a picture, a line of text, a tap. Nothing moves until the player is ready. The challenge is making the choices mean something.視覺小說是最適合閱讀的遊戲：一張圖、一行字、點一下。玩家沒準備好，什麼都不會動。挑戰在於讓選項有意義。

Here every choice carries a hidden tone: sweet, bold or sly. The same intention can be said three ways, and the characters react to the way, not just the content. Register, the thing textbooks explain in a grey box, becomes the main mechanic.這裡每個選項都帶著隱藏的語氣：甜、直或狡猾。同一個意圖可以有三種說法，角色回應的是說法，不只是內容。課本放在灰色方框裡解釋的「語域」，在這裡變成核心玩法。

A Doom meter shows how close Eve is to the book's bad ending. Bonds with each character rise and fall, and each episode ends with a title earned from the way you played ("Trendsetter").「厄運」量表顯示 Eve 離書中的壞結局有多近。和每個角色的好感會升降，每一集結束時依玩法得到一個稱號（例如「潮流先鋒」）。

Live demo · one moment, three tones現場示範・同一刻，三種語氣

Then a girl in a pink dress walks right up to me. In the book, Evangeline looks her up and down and says, "Who let the country mouse in?"接著，一個穿粉紅洋裝的女孩直直走向我。書裡，伊凡潔琳上下打量她，說：「誰把這隻鄉下老鼠放進來的？」

LILY Lady Evangeline! I'm Lily. I just wanted to say hello. Your dress is so beautiful.伊凡潔琳小姐！我是莉莉。我只是想來打聲招呼。您的禮服好美。

The lines are from Episode 1. The tone labels and the notes appear only in this demo; in the game the tone stays hidden.台詞來自第一集。語氣標籤和說明只出現在這個示範裡；遊戲中語氣是隱藏的。

The script is the game劇本就是遊戲
> In the book, Evangeline looks her up and down…
~ 書裡，伊凡潔琳上下打量她…
?
* "Thank you. Pink really suits you." [sweet] {lily+1, doom-2} -> lily_sweet
* "Stay away from that fountain today." [bold] {doom-1} -> lily_bold
* "Walk with me? The roses are better." [sly] {doom-1} -> lily_sly

== lily_sweet
LILY [smile]: Really? I made it myself!
~ 真的嗎？這是我自己做的！

Shortened from the real script. > is narration, ~ the Chinese line, [sweet] the tone, {…} the effects, -> the jump. The build refuses to run if a label, a tooltip word, a portrait or a song is missing.摘自正式劇本並縮短。> 是旁白，~ 是中文，[sweet] 是語氣，{…} 是效果，-> 是跳轉。只要缺了標籤、提示字、立繪或歌曲，建置就會拒絕執行。

Craft notes製作筆記

Callbacks. A choice sets a flag; three scenes later someone remembers it.回呼：選項設下旗標，三個場景之後有人記得。

Voices. Each character asks for a different browser voice and accent, so the read-aloud sounds like a cast.聲音：每個角色要求不同的瀏覽器語音和口音，朗讀聽起來像一整個卡司。

Art. 320 × 200 pixels, dithered like an old VGA game.美術：320 × 200 像素，像老 VGA 遊戲的網點。

A bot plays all nine routes before any person does.機器人在真人之前先玩完九條路線。

Saves. Three slots, plus a file to download.存檔：三個欄位，加上可下載的檔案。

The lesson stays outside the game課程留在遊戲外面

The game never shows a word list or a grammar box. Those live in a separate Coach's Companion for the teacher: each episode's words with KK and Chinese, phrases, grammar patterns with a quick task, tone comparisons and discussion questions, plus a Class view that shows one card at a time, large. The student plays at home; the class talks about it.遊戲裡從不出現單字表或文法框。這些放在給老師的「教練手冊」：每集的單字（KK 音標與中文）、片語、文法句型與小練習、語氣比較和討論題，還有一次放大顯示一張卡的上課模式。學生在家玩，課堂上來討論。

What's next下一步
Routes that split Today the choices bend the story and it comes back together. Next: whole routes that only open for a sweet, bold or sly player.會分岔的路線：現在選項會讓故事轉彎再匯合。下一步：只對甜、直或狡猾玩家開放的整條路線。
Seasons A new season each school term, with the same cast and one new character.季數：每學期一季，原班人馬加一個新角色。
Characters who each know a piece The answer is split among several people, and you have to ask each one, politely or not. A classroom idea from the 1990s ("meted-out information") that fits a visual novel perfectly.每人只知道一部分的角色：答案分散在好幾個人身上，你得一個個去問，客氣或不客氣都行。這是 1990 年代的課堂點子（「分配資訊」），和視覺小說完美契合。
Card auto-battler06 / 10

Play it half asleep.半睡半醒也能玩

Clock Out (躺平冒險團): office workers fight their way up a tower of strange office monsters, one floor at a time, until it's time to go home.《躺平冒險團》：上班族一層一層往上打，對抗辦公大樓裡的怪物，直到下班時間。

An auto-battler asks for almost nothing: pull cards, set a team of four, press Go, watch. That's the point. It's a game for the bus ride home, when nobody has energy for a lesson.自動戰鬥幾乎不要求什麼：抽卡、排四人隊伍、按出發、看。這正是重點。它是下班公車上的遊戲，那時沒有人有力氣上課。

The English rides in what the player looks at anyway: card names, skills, little quotes, and a battle log that scrolls by every fight. "Joe attacks for 12 damage." "The Glowing Mushroom hits Joe for 6 damage." The same patterns, hundreds of times, with nothing at stake.英文藏在玩家反正都會看的地方：卡名、技能、小語錄，還有每場都會捲過的戰鬥紀錄。「Joe attacks for 12 damage.」「The Glowing Mushroom hits Joe for 6 damage.」同樣的句型，重複幾百次，毫無壓力。

Chinese is the default; English is one tap away in the top bar. Whichever language is on, press and hold any card to see it in the other one.預設中文，英文在上方一鍵切換。無論開哪種語言，長按任何一張卡都能看到另一種語言。

Live demo · press and hold a card現場示範・長按卡片

Three made-up cards in Clock Out's style. Hold for the other language; let go and it flips back.三張仿 Clock Out 風格的自製卡片。按住看另一種語言，放開就翻回來。

One engine, many games一個引擎，很多遊戲

The combat lives in one shared engine. Every skill, combo and enemy ability is a small rule object that plugs into a fixed order of phases, and the random numbers are seeded, so a test can replay any fight exactly. A new game is new cards, new text and new art on the same engine.戰鬥寫在一個共用引擎裡。每個技能、組合和敵人能力都是一個小規則物件，插進固定順序的階段；亂數有種子，測試可以一模一樣地重播任何一場。新遊戲就是同一個引擎上的新卡片、新文字和新美術。

Why it works for English為什麼對英文有用

Repetition without drills. The log repeats a handful of patterns with new names each time.不用操練的重複：戰鬥紀錄用新名字重複幾個句型。

Collecting is reading. A new card is a reason to read its text, and its quote.收集就是閱讀：新卡是讀卡片文字和語錄的理由。

Long-press beats a toggle. The Chinese is there when you reach for it, and gone when you let go.長按勝過切換：伸手就有中文，放手就沒有。

Player-tested

Player comments gave Clock Out its long-term goal: reach floor 100. A long climb gives a quiet game a reason to come back tomorrow.玩家的意見給了 Clock Out 一個長期目標：爬到第一百層。一段長長的攀爬，讓安靜的遊戲有了明天再回來的理由。

What's next下一步
Cash Out A third game on the same engine, with a new setting and new cards.同一個引擎上的第三款遊戲，新場景、新卡片。
A deck-builder mode Short runs where you add one card after each fight: the roguelite from page 1, almost free on this engine.牌組構築模式：每場戰鬥後加一張卡的短局，就是第 1 頁的 roguelite，在這個引擎上幾乎免費。
A log you can tap Tap any line of the battle log to hear it and see the pattern it follows.可以點的戰鬥紀錄：點任何一行，聽它念出來，並看到它用的句型。
Tabletop RPG companions07 / 10

The table stays human.桌邊，還是人來帶

The Lost-and-Found of Kettlebrook is a 5E adventure for a teacher and a few students. Three web apps sit beside the table; the talking happens at it.《凱托溪鎮的失物招領處》是給一位老師和幾位學生的 5E 冒險。三個網頁程式放在桌邊，開口說話則在桌上發生。

A tabletop game is the one genre where speaking is the whole game: "I check the door." "Can I ask the goose?" No screen can replace a teacher who answers in character. So the apps carry the parts a table is bad at: rules, reading, handouts, and words to look up later.桌上遊戲是唯一一種「開口說」就是整個遊戲的類型：「I check the door.」「Can I ask the goose?」沒有螢幕能取代一位用角色身分回答的老師。所以程式負責桌子不擅長的部分：規則、閱讀、講義，以及之後查的單字。

The chapter titles are English idioms the adventure takes literally, so the phrase arrives with a story attached: Lost Track of Time, The King's Marbles, Keep Your Temper. The puzzles are language too: ring five bells in the order a lullaby gives, pair the odd socks by their patterns.章名是冒險故事照字面演出的英文慣用語，片語帶著故事一起出現：Lost Track of Time、The King's Marbles、Keep Your Temper。謎題也是語言：照搖籃曲的順序敲五口鐘，依花紋把襪子配成對。

"I hit the monster. Roll the dice." Beginners shrink the game to this. They need words at the moment of action.「我打怪物。擲骰子。」初學者會把遊戲縮成這樣。他們需要在行動的那一刻有字可用。The beginner's line, as Phillips (1993) reported it
What's next: three upgrades下一步：三項升級
1

Smarter companion apps更聰明的輔助程式

Phrase and action cards that appear at the moment of action: when it's your turn, the Player's Book offers "I sneak behind the…", "I try to talk to…", "I look closely at…", so a beginner says more than "I hit it." Shared dice that everyone sees roll, checks the DM calls from the guide, and handouts that unlock on every player's screen at once.在行動當下出現的句型與動作卡：輪到你時，玩家手冊提供「I sneak behind the…」「I try to talk to…」「I look closely at…」，讓初學者能說出比「I hit it.」更多的話。大家都看得到的共用骰子、主持人從指南發出的檢定，以及在每位玩家畫面同時解鎖的講義。

2

One app, two views一個程式，兩種畫面

Merge the three into one: a DM view and a player view of the same session. The hero from Hero Workshop walks straight into it, sheet and all. Live sync lets a remote student join the table from home, and an asynchronous mode turns a session into play-by-post, a move a day, the way play-by-email games ran in the 1990s.三合一：同一場遊戲的主持人畫面和玩家畫面。英雄工坊做的角色直接帶著角色卡走進來。即時同步讓在家的學生也能加入；非同步模式把一場遊戲變成「貼文接龍」，一天一步，就像 1990 年代的電子郵件遊戲。

3

A Kettlebrook you can walk around可以走進去的凱托溪鎮

A top-down, web-playable Kettlebrook RPG with the dialogue and action choices built in: walk the green, ask the baker, follow the goose. It's for practice after class, alone, on a phone. It doesn't replace the table; it sends students back to it with words ready.一款俯視角、網頁就能玩的凱托溪鎮 RPG，內建對話和行動選項：逛草地、問麵包師傅、跟著那隻鵝走。它是下課後一個人用手機練習用的。它不取代桌遊，而是讓學生帶著準備好的字回到桌邊。

Small box: the dragon on the title screen小方塊：標題畫面的龍

How. A 320 × 180 canvas filled pixel by pixel. Sky and glows use a 4 × 4 ordered dither for that old-game grain; the dragon and heroes are layers of palette shapes, outlined and shaded, then stamped in. Embers drift and the fire flickers at about 14 frames a second. With reduced motion on, it draws one still frame.做法：320 × 180 的畫布，逐像素繪製。天空和光暈用 4 × 4 有序網點做出老遊戲的顆粒感；龍和英雄是調色盤形狀的圖層，加外框、上陰影後蓋上去。火星飄動、火焰以每秒約 14 格閃爍。開啟減少動態時，只畫一張靜止畫面。

Could be better. A wing-beat and breath cycle for the dragon, idle moves for the heroes, a little parallax, palette cycling for the fire, sharper pixels on high-density screens, and a pause when the scene scrolls out of view.可以更好：龍的拍翅和呼吸循環、英雄的待機動作、一點視差、火焰的調色盤循環、高解析螢幕上更銳利的像素，以及畫面捲出視線時暫停。

Branching gamebooks08 / 10

The oldest game here.這裡最老的遊戲

Text, choices, and a little memory. The gamebooks came first, and they're the easiest to upgrade with everything the newer games learned.文字、選項，加上一點記憶。遊戲書最早做，也最容易用新遊戲學到的一切來升級。

Keep OutA2–B1

A cultivation master, three hundred years old, wins his last battle and wakes up in Taipei with 50,000 coins and no idea what rent is. Now he needs a room, a phone, and a magic ward to keep out the cockroaches, the mosquitoes and worse.一位修仙三百年的大師打贏最後一戰，醒來發現自己在台北，身上五萬塊，完全不知道房租是什麼。現在他需要房間、手機，還有一道結界，把蟑螂、蚊子和更糟的東西擋在外面。

Tracks money · rent · the ward around the room · story flags · pages seen記錄：金錢、房租、房間的結界、劇情旗標、看過的頁面

Achievement UnlockedA2

Same office, same coffee, same road, for five years. Then one night a game system switches on inside your life, and every small choice starts earning points.同一間辦公室、同一杯咖啡、同一條路，五年了。某天晚上，一個遊戲系統在你的人生裡啟動，每個小選擇都開始得分。

Tracks achievements · points · System messages記錄：成就、分數、系統訊息

Both are built the simplest way: a page of text, two or three choices, and a small state object that remembers what happened. The English is long-form reading, A2 to B1, with dotted hard words that open a plain-English definition and the Chinese.兩本都用最簡單的方式做：一頁文字、兩三個選項，加上一個記住發生過什麼的小狀態物件。英文是長篇閱讀，A2 到 B1，難字有虛線，點開是簡單英文解釋和中文。

What they don't have yet is everything the later games added: no voice, no music, no global Chinese setting, no saves you can carry to another phone. The upgrade path is a shopping list from the rest of this issue.它們還沒有的，正是後來的遊戲加上的東西：沒有語音、沒有音樂、沒有全域中文設定、沒有能帶到另一支手機的存檔。升級路線就是從本期其他遊戲列出的購物清單。

The upgrade path升級路線
AddWhat it does for a readerBorrow from
Read-aloudHear any paragraph, with the pronunciation fixes.朗讀：任何段落都能聽，含發音修正。Window Seat
MusicA theme per chapter sets the mood for long reading.音樂：每章一首主題曲，為長篇閱讀定調。Lamplight FM player
ArtOne picture per scene, so the reader can see the rooftop.美術：每個場景一張圖，讀者看得到那個頂樓。The pixel pipelines
Chinese, set onceA Settings switch for full-line Chinese, for readers below B1.一次設定的中文：設定裡開關整行中文，給 B1 以下的讀者。The Villainess

Early experiments早期實驗

Buen Camino, The Lost Phone and Night Train to Kyūfun came first: short gamebooks that tried out the format, the tooltips and the tone. Each one taught something the later games kept.《Buen Camino》《The Lost Phone》和《Night Train to Kyūfun》最早出現：試驗格式、單字提示和語氣的短篇遊戲書。每一本都教會了後來的遊戲一些東西。

Across every game09 / 10

Level up.升級

Each game page ended with its own next steps. These five would lift all of them at once.每個遊戲頁都有自己的下一步。這五項能一次提升全部。

01

Spaced review in the notebook筆記本裡的間隔複習

The notebook already knows which words you tapped and when. Bring a few back at the right moments: a word met on Monday reappears in Thursday's diary, then on a card at the start of the next block. The game schedules the review; the player just keeps playing.筆記本已經知道你點了哪些字、什麼時候點的。在對的時機讓幾個字回來：週一遇到的字，週四的日記裡又出現，下一個區塊開頭的卡片上再見一次。複習由遊戲排程，玩家只管繼續玩。

02

Install it, play offline安裝後離線玩

A single-file game is one step from a Progressive Web App: add a manifest and a small service worker, and it installs to a phone's home screen with an icon and runs on the MRT with no signal.單檔遊戲離漸進式網頁應用（PWA）只差一步：加一個 manifest 和一個小小的 service worker，就能裝到手機主畫面、有圖示，在沒訊號的捷運上也能玩。

03

Characters who can answer back會回話的角色

Let one character answer free questions through Claude, inside the story's limits: the baker knows the bakery, Pip knows the manor. Keep the written story as the backbone and use the open conversation for side moments. It needs a small server or an AI-enabled host, and a teacher who can see the logs.讓一個角色透過 Claude 回答自由提問，但在故事的範圍內：麵包師傅只懂麵包店，Pip 只懂莊園。寫好的故事仍是主幹，開放對話只用在支線時刻。這需要一個小伺服器或支援 AI 的平台，也需要老師看得到紀錄。

04

Writing prompts, if you want them寫作提示（想要再開）

An optional line at the end of a block or episode: "Write one sentence to Camille about the stall." Saved with the game and shown to the teacher.在區塊或集數結尾加一行可選的提示：「寫一句話給 Camille，說說攤位的事。」跟遊戲一起存檔，給老師看。

These games are for reading and listening after class; writing isn't their job. Keep this one off by default.這些遊戲是下課後讀和聽用的，寫作不是它們的任務。這項預設關閉。

05

A teacher's view老師的檢視頁

No accounts needed: a student exports a save file, the teacher drops it on a dashboard page that shows chapters played, choices made and words tapped. Everything stays in two browsers.不需要帳號：學生匯出存檔，老師把檔案拖進檢視頁，就看得到玩了哪些章節、做了哪些選擇、點了哪些字。所有資料只在兩個瀏覽器之間。

A flag on speech recognition關於語音辨識的提醒

It's tempting to add a microphone and score the player's pronunciation. Speaking practice usually happens better in class, with a human teacher who knows the student. Recognizers are tuned on native speakers, so they mishear many learners, and a game that keeps saying "try again" teaches a student to stop talking. Use the voice for listening, not for judging.加個麥克風幫玩家的發音打分數，聽起來很誘人。但口說練習通常在課堂上、和了解學生的真人老師一起做會更好。語音辨識以母語人士為基準調校，很多學習者會被聽錯；一款一直說「再試一次」的遊戲，只會教學生閉嘴。語音拿來聽，不要拿來評分。

Free inside10 / 10

Your kit.妳的工具包

A one-page canvas to plan a game before you build it, and the prompts to build it with Claude.一頁畫布，讓妳動手前先規劃遊戲；再附上和 Claude 一起做遊戲的提示。

The game-design canvas遊戲設計畫布

Fill it in here (it stays in this browser), then copy it into Claude as the start of your project.在這裡填寫（只存在這個瀏覽器），再複製貼給 Claude，當作專案的開頭。

The prompt card提示卡

Keep this open beside Claude. Copy a prompt, change the parts in [brackets], send.把這張卡放在 Claude 旁邊。複製一則，改掉中括號裡的內容，送出。

STUDIO is an InkQuest Web Craft magazine made by Wen-Hung Fang, November 2026. All screens are from the published InkQuest games, captured in a phone-sized browser. Illustrations drawn with vex; the music in the tour video made with chirp. vex and chirp are by uilianks (github.com/uilianks), MIT license. The hike demo uses Window Seat's own pixel sprites.本期所有畫面取自已發布的 InkQuest 遊戲，在手機尺寸的瀏覽器中擷取。插畫以 vex 繪製；導覽影片配樂以 chirp 製作。健行示範使用 Window Seat 本身的像素圖。
